title: The Light in the Castle
text: While staying near an old castle in Transylvania, I noticed a single light glowing from one of the upper towers long after midnight. Curious, I watched as a shadow passed slowly across the window, even though the castle was supposed to be abandoned. Moments later, the light vanished, leaving the tower completely dark. The locals later told me that the light appears whenever someone new arrives in the village.

title: The Midnight Parade
text: Walking through the French Quarter just before midnight, I heard distant music that sounded like a brass band. As I followed the sound, I saw a parade of figures dressed in old-fashioned clothing, their faces pale and expressionless. When I blinked, the street was suddenly empty and silent. A nearby shop owner later claimed that a ghostly parade appears on nights when the city is unusually quiet.

title: Footsteps on the Ice
text: While walking alone near the frozen outskirts of Reykjavík, I heard footsteps crunching behind me on the ice. Each time I turned around, no one was there, yet the footsteps continued to follow me. The sound stopped only when I reached a lit road. Later, I learned that travelers in the area often report being followed by unseen companions during winter nights.

title: The Last Bus Home
text: Waiting alone at a bus stop in Baguio late at night, I boarded what I thought was the last bus heading downhill. The ride was unusually silent, and none of the other passengers spoke or moved. When I got off, the bus drove away without headlights. The next morning, I was told that the route I took had been closed for years due to a fatal accident.

title: The Singing Gondolier
text: While staying near a quiet canal in Venice, I heard soft singing echoing through the fog in the early hours of the morning. A lone gondola passed by, steered by a gondolier whose face I could not see. As the gondola disappeared, the singing abruptly stopped, leaving an unsettling silence behind. Later, I discovered that a gondolier had drowned in that canal decades ago.
